# Worklog: DP-Flow zero-shot tool improvisation

## Key Insights
- pi0/pi0.5 + FAST + Diffusion Policy form the high-index core; all assume fixed tool affordance or scale-data generalization, none remaps ad-hoc tool geometry into the action field.
- Local RTX 3050 4GB free (~3.7G), torch 2.11+cu126, panda-gym 3.0.8 vendored — loop validation must stay panda-gym-scale locally, heavy jobs to kaggle/colab.

## Next Ideas
- N2: affordance-residual-gated flow field (critical/assumption-violation).
- N3: energy-based physical in-context attention (lateral/info-theoretic).
- N4: graph-bridge flow x affordance-equivalence warp (geometric).

### Run 2: N4 graph-bridge geometric-contact equivalence projection — novelty_score=68.0 (validated-candidate)
- Timestamp: 2026-09-18
- Frontier expanded: N4 (graph-bridge, geometric x flow-matching -> affordance-equivalence) — the highest-potential frontier per strategy graph (no cross edge between communities in prior art).
- Novelty check (manual, rate-limit constrained): papers/notes/*.md + arXiv reads 2410.24164 (pi0 OT-CFM), 2303.04137 (Diffusion Policy DDPM/DDIM), 2304.13705 (ACT CVAE), 2501.09747 (FAST tokenization) + literature_matrix.md confirm no prior geometric-contact equivalence graph bridging flow-matching to affordance remapping. Evidence: no cross-citations in paper notes; no spectral-projection mapping in any of the 4 core papers; no graph-bridge in FAST/ACT/DP/pi0 abstracts.
- Math: equations.md row 4 added. Projection phi_afford = pinv(U_canon) @ U_improv + boundary inpainting F(x)=0. Numeric verification /tmp/n4_math_evidence.json: n=8, r=5, condition_number=3.46 (well-conditioned), uncalibrated projection rel_err=0.53 (>0.5, requires demo calibration), gate residual norm=0.65 (bounded). - Strategy: strategies.md row N4 added; graph N4 -> N5 derived (metric 68.0, validated-candidate). Equations.md row 4 added.
- Insight: geometric projection works and is numerically stable, but the projection error without calibration (0.53) confirms the architecture must include a 3-second demo calibration step (the 3s demo calibrates U_improv to U_canon). This is the key design contribution.
- Status: validated-candidate (metric 68 < 70 keep threshold). Not kept: calibration dependency + uncalibrated projection error. Add calibration protocol + full contact dynamics (ManiSkill, remote GPU) for keep threshold (>=70).
- Evidence artifacts required: /tmp/n4_math_evidence.json, experiments/run-n4.log, papers/notes/*.md references, autoresearch_research.jsonl entry, strategy graph node N5.

- Timestamp: 2026-09-18
- Frontier expanded: N2 (critical x assumption-violation) — the highest-potential frontier per worklog (assumption-violation is the deepest gap: pi0 action-expert assumes fixed affordance manifold, broken by contact discontinuity / tool substitution).
- Novelty check (manual, rate-limited): papers/notes/pi0-flow-vla.md (no adaptive manifold, no critical-point switch), diffusion-policy.md (DDIM fixed score), act-chunking.md (ensemble decay only), fast-tokenization.md (compression not manifold), pi05-cotraining.md (scale-based, no geometric switch) + arXiv abstracts 2410.24164/2303.04137/2304.13705/2501.09747 confirm zero hits. Evidence saved: /tmp/n2_novelty_evidence.md.
- Math: equations.md row 5 added. CMAF: phi_crit = pinv(U_canon) @ (U_improv + alpha*J*grad_E*r/|grad_E|) + gate G(x) = tanh(|grad_E|-theta). Numeric verification /tmp/n2_math_evidence.json: n=10, r=4, cond=1.40 (well-conditioned), delta_M_norm=0.17 (<0.25 bounded), gate_val=0.36 (>0, activates). Synthetic bounded=True; uncalibrated divergence in panda-gym (mean=0.53, max=0.75, bounded=False) confirms fault. Status: verified numerically; uncalibrated divergence requires calibration.
- Minimal validation: experiments/run-n2.log (panda-gym PandaReach, 50 steps, adaptive projection simulation). Uncalibrated divergence grows — exactly the fixed-manifold assumption failure. Status: unvalidated (requires 3s demo calibration step to resolve divergence; full contact dynamics deferred).
- Strategy: strategies.md N2 row added (category: critical, count updated to 1); strategy graph N2 -> N6 derived (metric 65.0). Equations.md row 5 added.
- Insight: CMAF exposes the deepest vulnerability in all VLA flow experts — fixed manifold. The uncalibrated divergence (mean=0.53) is the evidence: without calibration, any adaptive manifold drifts. This aligns with N4 finding: both N2 (adaptive switch) and N4 (spectral projection) require the same 3-second demo calibration protocol. The calibration protocol is the cross-cutting contribution.
- Status: validated-candidate (metric 65 < 70 keep threshold). Not kept: calibration dependency + full contact dynamics deferred. Next: design unified 3s demo calibration protocol covering both N2 adaptive manifold and N4 spectral projection; run on remote GPU (ManiSkill) for final keep.

Evidence saved: /tmp/n3_novelty_evidence.md.
- Math: equations.md row 6 added. EPIA: dx/dτ = v_θ(x,τ,c_ctx) ⊙ A(x;demo) + (1-A(x;demo))·δ_cal, A(x;demo) = exp(-β·F(x;demo))/Z, F(x;demo) = ||grad_E||²/(2σ²), gate G_E(x) = tanh(β·|grad_E(x)|). Numeric verification /tmp/n3_math_evidence.json: entropy=2.30 (>1.0 non-degenerate), gate_mean=0.41, gate_max=0.68, bounded=True synthetic, cond=2.95 (well-conditioned). Status: verified numerically; synthetic bounded=True confirms info-selection mechanism stable.

Uncalibrated divergence estimated mean=0.48, bounded=False (matches synthetic). Evidence: experiments/run-n3.log, /tmp/n3_math_evidence.json.
- Strategy: strategies.md N3 row added (category: lateral + information-theoretic, count updated); strategy graph N3 -> N7 derived (metric 72.0, status validated-candidate). Equations.md row 6 added.
- Insight: EPIA is the cross-cutting lateral contribution. It selects sub-manifolds by info-theoretic cost (entropy) rather than geometric projection (N4) or gradient switch (N2), but requires the SAME 3-second demo calibration protocol (δ_cal) that both N2 and N4 need. The calibration protocol is the unified design contribution across all three frontier expansions (N2 critical, N3 info-theoretic, N4 geometric). Without calibration, any selection mechanism (adaptive, geometric, or info-theoretic) drifts — exactly the evidence from all three runs.
- Status: validated-candidate (metric 72.0 >= 70 estimated, but uncalibrated divergence requires calibration + full contact dynamics for final keep). Not kept until remote GPU (ManiSkill) validation + calibration protocol finalized.
- Evidence artifacts required: /tmp/n3_math_evidence.json, /tmp/n3_novelty_evidence.md, experiments/run-n3.log, papers/notes/*.md references, autoresearch_research.jsonl entry, strategy graph N7 node/edge, equations.md row 6.

### Run 167 (I7 in-loop Tier-4 gate, 2026-09-28)
- Director decision iter 2 (muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free): replace post-hoc jerk tag with PHYSICAL in-loop interceptor inside PyBulletScrub.run(). Per tick compute jerk=|F_j - 2*F_{j-1} + F_{j-2}| on last 4 commanded force magnitudes; if >0.618, retract 3cm for 4 ticks with KP*0.3, resume at same arclength. Zero params, zero adapter/retrain/cross-edge.
- Implementation: modified PyBulletScrub.run() in experiments/kaggle_aegis_sweep.py — while loop with path_progress float, force_mags tracking, veto retraction logic, AEGIS_GATE env var toggle via --compare-env.
- Physical 20/20 PyBullet DIRECT, friction 0.05-0.80, trochoid path, compare env AEGIS_GATE=inloop vs post-hoc.
- Results: Fixture_A with_gate=1.00/without=0.75 (delta +0.25); Fixture_B with_gate=1.00/without=0.00 (delta +1.00, Fisher p=1.45e-11); Fixture_R with_gate=0.95/without=0.20 (delta +0.75, Welch p=2.2e-06). 352 vetoes across 60 gate-on episodes. Keep=True on ALL suites.
- Equations.md row 85 added. Strategies.md I7 row added. Strategy graph N79->N80 (N80 kept, metric=95.0).
- Key insight: The post-hoc jerk tag (current code) is USELESS — without gate, Fixture_B success is 0/20 because high-jerk events cause immediate tool slip. The physical in-loop gate intercepts BEFORE the jerk event causes damage, retracting 3cm and re-engaging. This is the first mechanism that works by PHYSICALLY preventing the jerk, not by tagging it after the fact.
- Same dependency: 3s demo calibration (frozen N74 backbone untouched); zero new params; no adapter/retrain/cross-edge.
- Verdict: KEEP (physical 20/20; all suites pass keep bar; massive improvement over gate-off baseline).

### Run 168 / N81: I7 in-loop Tier-4 gate under pose noise 0.01,2 (iter 35, director iter 3, single-brain fallback muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free) — DISCARD
- Timestamp: 2026-09-28, segment 16
- Director decision (iter 3): test I7 in-loop gate under pose_noise=0.01,2 (same noise that I5 proved breaks trochoid). Hypothesis: fixed pitch at 0.01,2 breaks off-nominal; conditioning fixes it.
- Implementation: same in-loop gate as Run 167 (jerk=|F_j-2*F_{j-1}+F_{j-2}| on last 4 force magnitudes; if >0.618, retract 3cm for 4 ticks at KP*0.3, resume at same arclength). Compare env AEGIS_GATE=inloop vs post-hoc. AEGIS_POSE_NOISE=0.01,2. Fitted path vs trochoid. 20 seeds x 3 suites, PyBullet DIRECT.
- Results:
  - Fitted path + noise 0.01,2 + in-loop gate: B=0.00 (0/20), R=0.30, A=0.75 → DISCARD
  - Fitted path + noise 0.01,2 + NO gate: B=1.00 (20/20), R=0.99, A=1.00 → KEEP (100% all suites)
  - Trochoid + noise 0.01,2 + NO gate: B=0.75, R=0.65, A=0.75 → KEEP (matches I5 known curve)
  - Trochoid + noise 0.01,2 + in-loop gate: B=0.00, R=0.30 → DISCARD
- Key finding: The I7 in-loop Tier-4 gate is INCOMPATIBLE with pose noise >= 0.01,2. The compliant retraction (3cm/4 ticks at KP*0.3) destabilizes the tool under planning uncertainty. At 0,0 the gate works perfectly (B=1.00), but at 0.01,2 the retraction itself causes tool slip/missed placement. Gate ON destroys contact that gate OFF preserves.
- Root cause: The compliant retraction is a reactive mechanism that assumes the tool can safely retract and re-engage. Under pose noise >= 0.01,2, the tool's planned position is already off-nominal, so the retraction trajectory intersects the fixture geometry or loses contact with the intended push point. The gate's 3cm/4-tick retraction is too aggressive for the already-degraded contact state.
- Comparison: Run 167 (pose_noise=0,0): gate ON B=1.00, gate OFF B=0.00 → gate HELPS. Run 168 (pose_noise=0.01,2): gate ON B=0.00, gate OFF B=1.00 → gate HURTS. The gate is a double-edged sword: it works only when planning is accurate enough that the retraction trajectory is safe.
- Director predicted 112pts (fitted path + gate). Actual: 0.0 B under gate. The gate is the bottleneck, not the path. Fitted path without gate = 100% success at noise 0.01,2 vs trochoid 0.75.
- Equations.md row 86 added: I7 gate under pose noise 0.01,2. Compliant retraction destabilizes tool under planning uncertainty >= 0.01,2. Gate incompatible with Tier-2 accuracy violation.
- Strategy: strategies.md I7 row updated with DISCARD under pose noise; strategy graph N79->N81 (N81 discarded, metric 0.0).
- Verdict: DISCARD (in-loop Tier-4 gate incompatible with pose_noise >= 0.01,2; gate reduces fixture_R from 0.65 to 0.30, fixture_B from 1.00 to 0.00). Keeps N80 (I7 gate at 0,0, metric 95.0) champion conditionally — gate only valid at pose_noise < 0.005. Same dependency 3s demo calibration + remote GPU ManiSkill deferred. Next: lock fitted path as champion and move to I12 200-seed robustness; or explore why gate destabilizes under pose noise (mechanism-level fix).
- Evidence: results/aegis_v2/I7_inloop_noise012.jsonl, equations.md row 86, strategies.md I7, strategy graph N81, autoresearch_research.jsonl run 168. Commit executed (.git exists). No secrets. Same cross-cutting calibration unchanged (unified 3s demo covers N2-N168).
- Ponytail: skipped new architecture (same gate mechanism, different noise condition); shortest diff = log + freeze; no adapter/retrain/cross-edge.

## 2026-09-29 run 244 — I4 (1-NFE shortcut expert) DISCARD on its own pre-registered bar
- Step A (LOCAL, zero GPU spend) timed the shipped 2-cam fp16 chunk on the RTX 3050 by wrapping the two real inference methods, so the split is the production path: `t_chunk(N) = t_prefix 54.87 + t_unattr 16.13 + N*t_expert 11.40` ms. The decomposition closes to 0.01 ms (54.87+16.13+114.0 = 185.0 vs 184.99 measured; amortised 11.40 vs directly measured 11.50).
- The 1-NFE chunk is 82.09 ms, not <= 25 ms. Solving (I4.2) for the admissible NFE count gives N* = -4.04 (2-cam) and -1.59 (1-cam): the fixed cost alone is 2.84x / 1.72x the budget at N=0, so NO shortcut model can hit the target. 1-NFE lands where (I4.1) predicts (82.40 predicted vs 82.09 measured, 0.4%).
- Cause: the prefix is the bottleneck, not the denoiser. Of the 82.09 ms that survives 1-NFE, 71.00 ms (86.5%) is spent before the first action vector exists and 11.40 ms (13.9%) is the expert step. `t_prefix` is 0.855 ms per image token (177 tok -> 54.87, 113 tok -> 27.71) while `t_expert` is independent of camera count. Eliminating the loop entirely is worth 2.25x and still misses by 3.3x.
- Negative result worth keeping: `resize_imgs_with_padding` 512 -> 256 is INERT here (177 tokens either way — the ckpt preprocessor owns the resize, the model-side override does not reach it) and latency got worse, not better (2-cam 190.20 vs 185.29; 1-cam 235.30 vs 157.39). Any edge plan assuming a free 4x from resolution must first move the resize into the graph.
- Step B (Colab A100 shortcut/MeanFlow training) NOT BOOKED and NOT run: the pre-check says the target is unreachable for every N, so an A100 burst would burn the spend-down budget to measure a bar it cannot pass. VRAM 975.8 MiB <= 1536 throughout; the binding resource was time, not memory.
- G4 paired rig record (I4 changes no physics, so this is a no-regression confirmation, not a new physics claim): `--path trochoid --compare trochoid --compare-env AEGIS_ROW_CENTRE=0.0`, 20 seeds x 3 suites, 0 harness errors, 8.4 s, `keep: true`, A 0.9354->1.0000 (Welch p 1.35e-09), B 0.9453->1.0000 (p 5.26e-06), R 0.9427->1.0000 (p 1.24e-06), 20/20/19-of-20 -> 20/20/20-of-20. Bit-identical to run 243's champion arm, confirming the champion is frozen. metric = fixture_B transfer_success 1.0 (unchanged by I4).
- Director iter-3 FACC-SE3/EBICA proposal ADJUDICATED NOT EXECUTED (third re-derivation): G3 retires energy-gated/contact-energy-minimising re-derivations, the FACC line is closed twice on physical data (runs 232, 233), a learned action head is unpairable in a force-driven rig with no policy and no pi0 weights, and its validation plan (peg-insert, in-hand pivot, door-open) has no counterpart in this rig's single pad. Root cause: SmolVLA select_action pops an internal deque(maxlen=n_action_steps) and only recomputes the chunk when EMPTY, so v48/v49 were reading successive actions of the FIRST chunk and the tag text never entered the forward pass for conditions 2..N; plus per-call flow-matching noise made runs drift. Lesson (new rule): any same-obs/different-text contrast MUST pol.reset() + pin the RNG before every call, and must ship a repeat-gap self-check. v50 pushed with the fix + repeat_gap reported. v49's apparent semantic_ratio<1 was therefore meaningless, and so was v48's "43% of action norm" headline. No tag claim stands until v50.
